/* XXV — One shared naturalized mesh for fill, hit testing and ownership borders.
   River guidance uses the existing map hydrography; ridge axes are approximate.
   This is a stylized campaign map, not surveyed historical GIS boundaries.

   Development priorities retained from the player:
   - Country: budgets, ministries, political trade-offs and industrial specialisation (HOI4).
   - Army: persistent regiments, equipment weight, morale, fatigue and supply (Master of Command).
   - Navy: organisation means order delay and station keeping, never a universal ship speed.
     Extend flags, speaking trumpets, light gun carriages, crews, officers and damage control.
   - Naval encounters: persistent detection, pursuit, escape, slow tactical time, islands/landings.
   - Art: distinctive per-tech illustrations, procedural detailed portraits and modular ship meshes.
   - World: expand actual geographic coverage, preserve coastlines, use verified historical sources.
   - AI: scouting, supplies, objectives, retreat and coordinated reinforcement.
   - All modifiers must be shown numerically and consumed by simulation; avoid duplicate techs.
   Reference reading this iteration:
   https://www.euratlas.net/history/europe/1700/index.html
   https://steamcommunity.com/games/394360/announcements/detail/3712711277292318357
